_about: The STEMEd+ sites whose deadline calendars are combined here. Each build downloads every calendar (ics); if one cannot be reached, its deadlines from the last published deadlines.json are kept so nothing disappears for a day.
title: STEMEd+ Deadlines
tagline: Every deadline from across STEMEd+ Commons in one place: funding calls, conference proposals and registration, professional learning for K-12 teachers and informal educators, and faculty development for college instructors, graduate students, and postdocs. Subscribe once to get them all in your calendar.
